name: gym
description: A single-page PWA (`index.html`) with a workout routine planner (4-week Pull/Push/Legs cycle), a daily schedule with an active-plan banner, macro/water/meal tracking, and analytics (volume, cardio, muscle balance, V-taper). A companion page (`Gym.html`) offers a simulated training-log sandbox. Sync between devices goes through the Vercel serverless function in `api/sync.js`, with the browser's `localStorage` acting as the per-device source of truth.
